initial_plan.can_answer: yes, for the number of pedestrians recorded as killed in police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes in each requested calendar year
initial_plan.denominator: none; annual count total across eligible crash rows
initial_plan.population: police-reported motor vehicle crashes with crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025

data_check.meaning_and_decisions: The 2,132,218 police-reported crash rows with a crash_date in 2013-2025 are included, with no additional row filters. Each requested year has recorded dates spanning January 1 through December 31; the file does not appear to cover any requested year only in part based on its observed date range. crash_date is not missing in the file, is typed as DATE, and neither checked default date occurs. number_of_pedestrians_killed is missing on 0 rows in every requested year, so no outcome rows are excluded and no totals require imputation. The population remains the recorded police-reported crashes dated in each requested calendar year; this does not establish completeness beyond the file's reporting scope.

final_plan.can_answer: yes, the dataset supports annual recorded pedestrian-fatality counts for the requested years
final_plan.metric: annual total of number_of_pedestrians_killed, summed across eligible crashes
final_plan.denominator: none; this is a count total, not a rate or share
final_plan.population: all police-reported motor vehicle crashes in the file with crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025
filters: crash_date from 2013-01-01 inclusive to 2026-01-01 exclusive; no other filters
final_plan.years: 2013-2025 inclusive; observed crash_date spans January 1 through December 31 in each year
final_plan.limitations: Counts represent pedestrian deaths recorded in this police-reported crash file, not independently verified citywide totals. The outcome column has no missing rows in the requested years, and observed dates span each full calendar year; this check cannot verify completeness outside the file's reporting scope.
